# eApps

> llms.txt for the eApps repository (embeddedos-org/eApps).
> Status: the EmbeddedOS marketplace and app store —
> app packaging, distribution, and install-time permissions
> for the ecosystem.

eApps is where EmbeddedOS applications are published, found,
and installed: the marketplace architecture, the platform
guide for app authors, and the AI capability permission model
apps declare in their manifests.


## Docs

- [eApps Architecture](docs/architecture.md)
- [EoS Marketplace Architecture](docs/marketplace-architecture.md)
- [eApps Platform Guide](docs/platform-guide.md)
- [Adding a New App](docs/adding-apps.md)
- [AI capability permissions — install-time permission model](docs/ai-capability-permissions.md)
